summary: Joey Walker (PB South candidate) REFUNDABLE trip, ABI-DFW-PBI 11-13 Nov 2026: American Main Cabin Flexible (fully refundable), cap $1,400 all in; replaces 2026-10-22-1037d4
detail: KEV'S RULE (23 Oct 2026): fully refundable fare so the flight can be returned if Joey cannot make it in November. IMPORTANT: NOT LIVE-PRICED. aa.com, Google Flights and Kayak search pages returned 403 or empty results to my tools on 23 Oct 2026, so no 11/13 Nov refundable fare was opened. The flight amount below is a CAP, not a quote (UNVERIFIED planning ceiling, A). ITINERARY (times are the nearest schedule seen 22 Oct, UNVERIFIED for the dates; flight numbers not seen): Out Wed 11 Nov 2026, American ABI to DFW to PBI, depart ABI about 8:00am, land PBI about 2:39pm (backup ABI 1:39pm lands 10:23pm, too late for comfort). Back Fri 13 Nov, American PBI to DFW nonstop about 3:24pm (land about 5:50pm), then DFW to ABI evening connection, home about 9pm (connection UNVERIFIED; depends on PB South finish time). Fallback if the ABI connection times do not work: drive ABI to DFW and fly American DFW-PBI nonstop (Option 3). FARE CLASS AND REFUND RULE: American Main Cabin Flexible (a fully refundable Main Cabin fare), NOT Basic and NOT standard Main Cabin. American's conditions of carriage: a refundable ticket cancelled before travel starts is refunded the full ticket amount to the original form of payment (credit card, within about 7 business days). Standard Main Cabin cancels to travel credit only, which does NOT meet Kev's rule. Source for the rule: search summary of aa.com conditions of carriage and secondary travel sites; aa.com pages themselves would not open (403), so the booker must read the fare rule on the booking screen and confirm it says Refundable / refund to original form of payment BEFORE paying. If the screen shows credit-only, do not book; come back to Kev. HOTEL: Courtyard by Marriott West Palm Beach (Northpoint Pkwy), 2 nights 11-13 Nov, book the flexible/free-cancellation rate (cancel free until about 4pm the day before, confirm at booking), about $150 a night, about $340 with tax (Nov rate UNVERIFIED; 19 Oct sample $116). Pay-later, not prepaid. GROUND: rideshare PBI to hotel and back, about $60. CAP: flight up to $1,000 round trip refundable + hotel $340 + ground $60 = $1,400. Approval means Noah (per plan, on Kev's yes) books ONLY if the refundable fare on aa.com is at or under $1,000 and the screen confirms cash refund to the card; anything higher comes back to Kev. Nothing booked or held. Joey's legal name, DOB and TSA details go to the booker directly, never into the repo. Silence means nothing is booked.
